title: Sharing Is Beautiful
summary: Salma shares cakes with her neighbour and her friend, learning to honour her neighbours. (Bukhari and Muslim, on honouring neighbours)
moral: Sharing does not make us poorer. Honour your neighbours and love your friends, and our hearts become happy.
pages: That morning Mother made many fragrant cakes. Salma waited impatiently in the kitchen. 'Wow, Mother's cakes must be so delicious!' she said.

'Salma, there are so many cakes,' said Mother. 'The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وسلم said, "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honour his neighbour." (Bukhari and Muslim). How about we share some with Grandma Aminah next door?' Salma agreed.
Salma carefully carried a plate of cakes to the neighbour's house. She knocked on the door and gave the greeting, 'Assalamu'alaikum, Grandma Aminah!'
Grandma Aminah opened the door and smiled widely. 'Wa'alaikumussalam, Salma! Thank you, dear.' Salma replied, 'You are welcome, Grandma.' Grandma prayed for her lovingly, 'Jazakillahu khairan.'

On the way home, Salma met Rafi, her friend, who was sitting alone and hungry because he had forgotten to bring his lunch. Salma still had one cake, and she shared it with Rafi. 'This is for you, Rafi,' she said with a smile.
Rafi smiled widely and said, 'Jazakillah khairan, Salma!' Salma went home with a warm heart. She learned that sharing does not make us poorer; it adds happiness and friendship. The end.
